Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), June volume, plate for the 21st, filed by Commons under Category:Julian of Tarsus. 21 June is the martyr Julian of Tarsus in Cilicia, which is the folder's martyr - not the 8 January Julian kept with Basilissa, nor the 13 November or 28 November Julians, which stand separately in the series.
